        services.AddSingleton<IDatabase>(new MockDatabase());

        Assert.Contains("IDatabase", exception.Message);
    }

        var services = new ServiceCollection();

        // Act

        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var factory = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<ServiceFactory<RedisHashSetCollection<string, TestRecord>>>("test");
        var collection = factory(serviceProvider, "test");

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(collection);
    }
